h1: Land Clearing in the Bemidji & Leech Lake Area
metaTitle: Land Clearing in Bemidji & Leech Lake, MN | Shepard
metaDesc: Lot clearing, tree and stump removal for lake lots and new builds across Northern Minnesota. Family-owned since 1997. Call Shepard at (218) 224-2754.
lead: Opening up a lake lot or getting a building site ready? We clear lots, drop and remove trees, and pull stumps so you can get started.
factors: Size of the area being cleared
What you want done with the debris (haul, pile, or burn)
timeline: A small lot can be a day or two. Bigger clearing jobs depend on the trees and the terrain, and we will give you a window up front.
expect: We clear what you mark, haul off or pile the debris, and leave the lot ready for the next step. Lake-lot work is something we do a lot of around here.

faqs.a: Yes, all the time. Tight lots and tree-lined shorelines are common around here and we know how to work them.

faqs.q: Do you haul the debris away?
faqs.a: We can haul it off, pile it, or work with however you want it handled.

faqs.q: Do you grade the lot after clearing?
faqs.a: Yes. We can leave it rough or graded and ready to build on, whichever you need.
Yes, stump removal is part of clearing a site properly.
